Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan film 'Haiwaan' advance booking details released

Advance booking figures for the film 'Haiwaan', starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, have been released. The film sold 2,660 tickets and earned ₹6.86 lakh on its first day of advance booking. Details regarding the film's CBFC certificate, runtime, and plot have also been made available.
